title: Strategy detail loads its own data first and the rest after it is shown

problem_register_binding.operator_approval: 2026-11-25 conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好)
problem_register_binding.hosted_read_only_diagnosis: 2026-11-25 06:35Z to 07:16Z on BFF adc027da9 and after Root 45603700953 (BFF c3164945a; FE 38e5337d1) at 13:35Z: GET /bff/strategies/strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa alone took 2.4 to 5.3 s, but on the page took 6.5 s because eleven secondary reads started at the exact same moment as the primary read.

details: useLiveDetail in StrategyDetail.tsx now sends only bffV1.strategies.get(entityId) first without firing any secondary reads while the primary read is in flight.

Secondary reads are triggered via TabSectionLoader only after the primary strategy read resolves and renders the page, and each tab-only section (Experiments, Risk & Alerts, Incidents, Artifacts, Evolution, Governance, Lineage, Audit, Spec versions, Data & Features, Performance, Paper-Live) loads only when its tab is opened and retains its own loading and unavailable state.
The unused bffV1.jobs.list() read is removed from StrategyDetail, and neither bffV1.artifacts.list() nor managementConsoleReads.lineage(entityId) is sent on the overview tab.
Opening the Artifacts tab loads lineage and artifacts on open and filters to this strategy's lineage artifact IDs; tab labels do not show zero counts from unrequested reads.
Live refreshes and realtime events keep the currently displayed strategy data and any ready section data without blanking the page.
Failed secondary reads never blank the page, and existing 404 ('找不到策略'), 503, network error, and unavailable strategy payload behaviors remain unchanged.

StrategyDetail.test.tsx proves via a deferred primary strategy read that callOrder is strictly ['strategies.get'] while primary is pending, ['strategies.get', 'watchers.forSubject', 'decisionJournal.forSubject'] once the overview renders, and that tab-only reads fire only when their tab is opened.

e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts verifies in Chromium that opening /management/strategies/strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa sends only shell reads (GET /bff/me, GET /bff/actions, GET /bff/events/stream, GET /bff/management/shell-summary), the primary read (GET /bff/strategies/strategy-persona-a81b4fd15944698341aa), and after the primary read answers, the single overview secondary HTTP read (GET /bff/agora/journal), with zero requests before primary answers and zero requests to /bff/jobs, /bff/artifacts, or /bff/management/lineage on overview.
Locale parity passes across all 17 tests in src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts.
No existing test was weakened or deleted in the scoped test suites (42/42 tests pass across the 7 scoped StrategyDetail test files).

However, src/management/__tests__/fullOperationAssembly.test.tsx:152-158 (which runs in Branch CI Gate's full `npm run test` step) renders StrategyDetail on the overview tab without opening any other tab and asserts `expect(screen.getByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent('Some strategy data could not be loaded')` for `it.each(['jobs', 'audit', 'approvals', 'alerts', 'incidents', 'artifacts', 'research', 'evolution'])`. Because AC1 and AC2 forbid sending jobs, artifacts, and tab-only reads on the overview tab, that test must open the corresponding tab (and drop 'jobs' from the overview failure list, with justification in evidence per AC5), but `execute-plans:src/management/__tests__/fullOperationAssembly.test.tsx` is missing from the task's `artifacts` contract.

validation.command: ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test e2e/06-entity-registry.spec.ts --grep "renders StrategyDetail header and recorded pool rules within 2 s" && ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test e2e/13-agora.spec.ts
